verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents CLI subcommands, quick-select, scrollback search, and SSH/multiplexing features, but nowhere mentions a searchable command palette for discovering/running actions. A community comment even notes that WezTerm's many features 'are not really discoverable,' reinforcing the absence of such a UI. Missing for 10: any documentation or user report of a command-palette UI, its keybinding, or its action list.
